item.title: The fantasy of starships is no more realistic than magic
item.description: Interstellar travel — the kind in Star Trek, Star Wars, Dune — will never happen. The fantasy "exists on the exact same level of plausibility as wizards," argues Jason Pargin, author of John Dies at the End.
